Mickleham teenager Darweish Mohamed was found with critical wounds outside the Craigieburn community hospital at about 7.50pm on Wednesday. A staff member from the clinic rushed to his aid and delivered CPR, but he died at the scene. On Friday, police confirmed they had charged two people following arrests in the nearby suburb of Pascoe Vale early on Thursday.

Loved ones of a 15-year-old boy who was allegedly stabbed and left to die outside a hospital have asked the community to keep him in its prayers. Mickleham teenager Darweish Mohamed was found with critical wounds outside Craigieburn Community Hospital about 7.50pm on Wednesday. A staff member from the clinic rushed to his aid and delivered CPR, but he died at the scene. On Friday, police confirmed they had charged two people following arrests in the nearby suburb of Pascoe Vale early on Thursday. A 16-year-old boy from the Goulburn Valley was charged with murder and remanded in custody to appear in a children's court. A 20-year-old man from Beveridge was charged with criminal damage by fire and bailed to appear at Broadmeadows Magistrates Court on December 1.

A 16-year-old boy, from Victoria’s Goulburn valley region, was charged with murder and remanded in custody to appear in a children’s court, police said on Friday morning. A 20-year-old man from Beveridge was also charged with criminal damage by fire and bailed to appear at the Broadmeadows magistrates court on 1 December. Police said they were also investigating if a burnt-out car found at Oaklands Junction is linked to the stabbing. A friend of the dead boy’s family, Mohamed Bakhit, has launched a GoFundMe campaign to raise funds to meet the family’s funeral expenses. “It is with heavy hearts that we share the passing of our beloved brother, Darweish,” the fundraiser page reads. “No family should ever have to go through a loss like this, and our hearts are with his loved ones during this incredibly difficult time.”

[Lähde: Mandurah Mail]
Loved ones of a 15-year-old boy who was allegedly stabbed and left to die outside a hospital have asked the community to keep him in its prayers.

Mickleham teenager Darweish Mohamed was found with critical wounds outside Craigieburn Community Hospital about 7.50pm on Wednesday.

A staff member from the clinic rushed to his aid and delivered CPR, but he died at the scene.

On Friday, police confirmed they had charged two people following arrests in the nearby suburb of Pascoe Vale early on Thursday.

A 16-year-old boy from the Goulburn Valley was charged with murder and remanded in custody to appear in a children's court.

A 20-year-old man from Beveridge was charged with criminal damage by fire and bailed to appear at Broadmeadows Magistrates Court on December 1.

Police are also investigating if a burnt-out car found at Oaklands Junction is linked to the stabbing.

A friend of the dead boy's family, Mohamed Bakhit, launched a GoFundMe campaign to raise funds to meet the family's funeral expenses.

"It is with heavy hearts that we share the passing of our beloved brother, Darweish," the fundraiser page reads.

"No family should ever have to go through a loss like this, and our hearts are with his loved ones during this incredibly difficult time."

The campaign had raised more than $37,000 towards a goal of $60,000 by Friday morning.

It asks those who are unable to donate to keep Darweish and his family in their du'as, an Arabic word for a form of Islamic prayer.

Asked about the Mount Ridley College student's death, the education department confirmed it would provide support to affected school communities.

"The death of any young person is a tragedy," a spokesperson told AAP.

"The death of the young person in a violent incident on Wednesday will be extremely distressing for the local communities involved."

On Friday, police also announced they had made further arrests as part of the same investigation.

A 15-year-old girl from the Fawkner area was detained and charged with affray and theft of a motor vehicle.

She was bailed to appear in a children's court.

And a 15-year-old Craigieburn boy was being interviewed after his arrest on Friday morning.

payload.title: 15-vuotias Darweish Mohamed kuoli sairaalan ulkopuolella Melbournessa
payload.summary: Darweish Mohamed löydettiin kriittisesti loukkaantuneena Craigieburn Community Hospitalin ulkopuolelta keskiviikkoiltana. Poliisin mukaan 16-vuotiasta poikaa syytetään murhasta, ja toinen mies on saanut syytteen tulipaloon liittyvästä vahingonteosta.
payload.content:
Darweish Mohamed, 15, kuoli keskiviikkoiltana Melbournen pohjoisosassa sen jälkeen, kun hänet löydettiin kriittisesti loukkaantuneena Craigieburn Community Hospitalin ulkopuolelta noin kello 19.50. Poliisin mukaan tapausta tutkitaan väitettynä puukotuksena, ja 16-vuotias poika on saanut murhasyytteen.

## Apua annettiin sairaalan ulkopuolella

Micklehamista kotoisin ollut Mohamed löydettiin sairaalan ulkopuolelta vakavasti haavoittuneena. Sairaalan työntekijä riensi hänen avukseen ja aloitti elvytyksen, mutta poika kuoli tapahtumapaikalla. Läheiset ovat pyytäneet yhteisöä muistamaan Mohamedin perhettä rukouksissa.

Perheen ystävä Mohamed Bakhit on käynnistänyt GoFundMe-varainkeruun hautajaiskulujen kattamiseksi. Keräyssivulla Mohamedin kuolemaa kuvataan raskaaksi menetykseksi. Siinä todetaan, ettei yhdenkään perheen pitäisi joutua kokemaan vastaavaa menetystä, ja perheen läheisille esitetään tukea vaikeana aikana.

## Kaksi ihmistä sai syytteet

Poliisi kertoi perjantaina, että kaksi ihmistä oli saanut syytteet varhain torstaina Pascoe Valessa tehtyjen pidätysten jälkeen. Victorian Goulburn Valleyn alueelta kotoisin oleva 16-vuotias poika on saanut syytteen murhasta. Hänet on määrätty tutkintavankeuteen, ja hänen on määrä esiintyä lasten tuomioistuimessa.

Beveridgestä kotoisin oleva 20-vuotias mies on saanut syytteen rikollisesta vahingonteosta tulipalolla. Hänet on vapautettu takuita vastaan, ja hänen on määrä saapua Broadmeadowsin magistrates-tuomioistuimeen 1. joulukuuta.

## Poliisi selvittää palaneen auton yhteyttä

Poliisi tutkii myös, liittyykö Oaklands Junctionista löydetty palanut auto väitettyyn puukotukseen. Julkisuuteen kerrottujen tietojen perusteella tutkinta jatkuu, eikä viranomaiset ole vahvistaneet kaikkia tapahtumien yksityiskohtia.

Syytteet koskevat tässä vaiheessa poliisin ilmoittamia epäilyjä, ja asian käsittely etenee oikeusjärjestelmässä. Tapauksesta kerrotuissa tiedoissa korostuvat sekä nuoren kuolema sairaalan ulkopuolella että se, että avun antaminen alkoi heti klinikan työntekijän saavuttua paikalle.
